interpretation: Four instrument stations and their symmetric coupling weights. All diagonal weights are zero. This is a finite unlabeled grouping model, not evidence that the station locations themselves form biological populations.
spectral_policy: Use the UNNORMALIZED weighted Laplacian L=diag(degree)-A. Fiedler eigenvalue means the second smallest eigenvalue, counting multiplicity. Classify eigenvalues equal within1e-9. A normalized Fiedler vector is unique only up to sign when that eigenvalue is simple.
discrete_policy: Independently assess ALL unordered bipartitions into exactly two groups of two stations. Cut cost is the sum of each undirected crossing-edge weight ONCE. Return every minimum-cost partition by its side containing A; sort the two IDs in each side lexically, but the order of returned sides is immaterial. Do not grade an arbitrary second eigenvector sign split as the unique discrete answer.

provenance.data_origin: Project-constructed numerical studies with explicit physical/statistical working assumptions; not experimental performance claims.
